answer: A bond is refunded only after 21 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The jade counter is kept in forge and walnut reveals each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 21 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 290 aliases cost 397 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
